annual_summary.note: Field names are inherited from the planner engine. new_policy_sales = GBE engagements; cost_per_new_policy_sale = cost per GBE engagement; quote_starts = viewable GBE impressions; quote_to_policy_conversion = impression-to-engagement rate.

monthly_budget_weights_note: February, April-May, July-August and October-November carry bp's quarterly results windows; April includes the AGM. The weights are a synthetic planning assumption for this demo, not evidence of bp's actual phasing.
